item.title: Protests over high NIPSCO bills outside of company's headquarters
item.description: A group of protesters stood outside NIPSCO's headquarters in Merrillville, Ind. on Wednesday. People are angry about their utility bills and they want financial relief.NIPSCO's representatives appeared in Indianapolis for an evidentiary hearing on Wednesday. The company is under investigation by the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission for billing discrepancies involving their automated gas meters. item.title: Man killed in interstate crash in Des Plaines: state police
item.description: A man is dead after a crash on Interstate 294 in Des Plaines late Wednesday afternoon, authorities said.The crash occurred around 4:40 p.m. on northbound I-294, north of Golf Road, according to Illinois State Police Troop 3.The left three lanes of the interstate are temporarily closed following the crash. item.title: New bill would ban ICE agents from becoming law enforcement officers in Illinois
item.description: An Illinois state senator is backing legislation that would prohibit federal immigration agents from becoming law enforcement officers in the state.Sen. item.description: Galewood residents are taking matters into their own hands — holding a meeting Wednesday evening to discuss the future of the former Mars candy factory on the city’s Far Northwest Side — after proposed development plans were not met with widespread support.
